note: Provus Mega Menu is a presentation-only module for the Provus base theme. It has no settings form (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no config schema, and no plugins. Its only PHP is hook_theme() (registers theme hook menu__extras -> template menu--extras.html.twig, base hook menu_item_extras) and hook_form_alter() on menu_link_content_main_form, which uses #states to show field_provus_menu_callout_image + field_provus_menu_callout_link on top-level items and field_provus_menu_icon on child items. Those callout/icon fields are NOT created by the module - the Provus recipe attaches them to menu_link_content (the 'main' menu bundle). Medium/hard cases are grounded in exactly those field references: introspection finds the callout link field the module reads; execution attaches the per-item icon field the template renders. Field TYPE is not what is tested (any type with the right machine name satisfies the module); scripts avoid the theme registry.

evals.prompt: What does the provus_mega_menu module do in Drupal, and does it have an admin configuration page? Which module does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It is a presentation/theming module for the Provus base theme that renders the main menu as a full-width multi-column mega menu with callout panels and icons. It has no admin settings page (configure=null); its behavior comes from a Twig template, CSS/JS library and a form_alter. It depends on menu_item_extras.

evals.prompt: Which theme hook and template does provus_mega_menu register, and which module's rendering does it override?
evals.expected_output: hook_theme() registers the theme hook menu__extras using template menu--extras.html.twig with base hook menu_item_extras, so it overrides the Menu Item Extras menu rendering. It also attaches the provus_mega_menu/main-nav library.

evals.prompt: provus_mega_menu shows some fields only on top-level menu items and another only on child items via its form_alter. Name those fields and where they come from.
evals.expected_output: On menu_link_content_main_form it uses #states so field_provus_menu_callout_image and field_provus_menu_callout_link show only on top-level items (menu_parent main:) and field_provus_menu_icon only on child items. The module does not create these fields - the Provus recipe attaches them to menu link content; the template renders them.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a field used by the provus_mega_menu callout panel has been attached to the main menu's menu link content. Inspect the live fields on the menu_link_content 'main' bundle and give the machine name of the Provus mega-menu callout link field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_provus_menu_callout_link, attached to menu_link_content bundle 'main' (a link field the mega-menu template renders in the level-1 callout panel).

evals.prompt: provus_mega_menu renders a per-item icon on child menu links from the field field_provus_menu_icon, but that field is missing on this site. Attach field_provus_menu_icon to the menu_link_content 'main' menu bundle so the module can render icons, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A FieldStorageConfig field_provus_menu_icon on entity type menu_link_content plus a FieldConfig on bundle 'main' exist (create both and save). The module's template reads item.content.field_provus_menu_icon on child links; field type is not important.
